reviewed_by: Claude review of the remaining first-page scans
reason: Two more lookups had the defect #386 fixed elsewhere: they read the first 1,000-row page of a kind (list_entities orders oldest first) and filtered in Python. AutomationRuntime._authorize_or_request decided 'approval has already been consumed' by scanning the first 1,000 CommandExecution rows for metadata.approval_id, so once a Core had recorded more than 1,000 command executions a consumed approval was no longer visible to the check and the same approval could authorize the command again from another managed session; the check now asks NebulaStore.has_entity_with_metadata, which tests metadata.approval_id in SQL. ChatService.attach_native_run_to_chat looked for an existing mission chat in the first 1,000 sessions of the project, so past 1,000 conversations every 'Continue in chat' created a duplicate conversation for the same mission; it now pages through the project's sessions. test_session_record_lookups gains both beyond-1,000 cases; test_automation_runtime covers the authorization path that calls the new store query.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (matched through storage.py and the remaining-core fallback) is the real-Core journey suite; the defects only appear past 1,000 rows, which the Python tests create directly. No full suites.
